name: arcs
description: ARCS / flashesofbrilliance family skills for Claude Code. Each plugin references its own upstream repo (single source of truth) and installs one skill.

plugins.name: rca
plugins.description: On-demand root-cause analysis for a specific error. Use when a build/test/runtime failure is worth structured treatment — diagnosed at the cause, not the symptom.

plugins.name: state-sync
plugins.description: Scaffolds a committed snapshot.json so any session (local or cloud) restores ground-truth project state cheaply instead of re-deriving it. Run once per project.

plugins.name: token-savings-bank
plugins.description: Choose model tier, batching, inline-vs-subagent, and checkpointing deliberately on large/repetitive/cost-metered coding tasks — without trading away correctness.

plugins.name: fix-toolbar-comments
plugins.description: Fetch open Vercel Toolbar comment threads, implement the requested fixes, commit, deploy to production, and resolve each thread.

plugins.name: resume-tailor
plugins.description: Tailor a resume + matching cover letter to a specific role from your real evidence. Honesty-graded and falsifier-gated (refuses to state what it can't defend), lead-with-strengths projected, print-safe with an ATS-plain companion, and run through an adversarial pre-send gauntlet.
